remarks: Welcome to your serene oasis at The Vue New Canaan! This top-floor, quiet unit offers the ultimate convenience of single-level living. Step out your door and find the gym, club room, terrace, and storage room just across the hallway.  The living room, with its vaulted ceiling and skylights, is filled with natural light, creating a bright and airy atmosphere that you'll love coming home to. The primary bedroom features an en-suite bathroom, a walk-in closet, and a cozy gas fireplace. The bonus room, with its useful skylight, is perfect as an office, additional bedroom, or playroom-whatever suits your needs.  Imagine unwinding on the spacious rooftop terrace, watching the sunset while grilling dinner or relaxing by the fire pits. The building also offers wonderful amenities for all and pet owners, including a playground and a lush park for dogs.  Professionally managed, The Vue New Canaan provides a variety of services, including maintenance and concierge, ensuring a hassle-free living experience. The parking garage, conveniently located on the lower level, even includes a pet washing room for your furry friends.  Located just a stone's throw from the town center, train station, schools, and parks, this home offers the perfect blend of tranquility and convenience. Come and experience the warmth and comfort of The Vue New Canaan!
